entities.summary: Jack Pinnington Jones is a British professional tennis player. He has a career-high singles ranking of No. 134 achieved on 2 March 2026 and a doubles ranking of No. 966 achieved on 17 March 2025. He is the current British No. 5 in singles. He has won five titles on the ITF Men's World Tennis Tour and one title on the ATP Challenger Tour.
